profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: At General Motors, I own CI/CD pipeline architecture and deployment automation for a vision based AI manufacturing platform that monitors conveyor health across 15+ global sites using camera based detection. I've cut release times by over 98% through custom automated pipelining, led infrastructure migrations from VMware to Red Hat Linux and on prem to cloud, and partner closely with security teams to remediate container vulnerabilities and maintain enterprise compliance. On the application side, I've delivered features including real time camera setting adjustments and automated feed quality detection, reducing configuration time and improving monitoring reliability. I also manage end to end deployment workflows, including release orchestration, environment configuration, and lifecycle management, across a large, distributed server fleet.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: The job of a Resident Assistant (RA) is to foster and build a community for around 40 residents. RAs are responsible for ensuring campus and housing policies are upheld by being on call and performing duty rounds of all the housing buildings. Another responsibility is to plan and host large-scale educational and social events to bring the residential community together.

positions.title: Lead Student Assistant - Department of Housing and Residential Education
positions.description: I supervised a team of six student assistants and delegated all tasks and projects to ensure completion in a timely manner. I accurately input student data into Odyssey Management System and gathered data for staff members whenever needed. I participated in the testing of a new housing data management system and led a project to have all documents from the last seven years uploaded electronically to keep up-to-date records. I provided marketing advice by conducting research, holding focus groups, surveys, and interviews of students living on and off-campus to make recommendations on how to increase the student housing population. I analyzed the cost of living in surrounding housing complexes by CSUSB to give our leadership team better insight into the cost of housing for the following academic year. I also performed clerical duties such as answering phone calls, giving tours of the housing complexes, made campus deliveries, and oversaw the training of other student assistants.

positions.title: Service Management Office Operations Intern
positions.description: I assisted the Identity and Access Management Technology leads with documenting, standardizing, and providing clarity to their operational service offerings in the form of catalogs to better assist our customers. I also analyzed pending access requests at Southern California Edison to create a Power BI dashboard that would allow the Identity and Access Management Operational leads to easily identify the current approval stage for access requests and also gain a better understanding as to where access requests are spending the most time in a pending state. I also presented the Power BI dashboard to senior managers in the IT department.

positions.title: Associate Student Body Treasurer
positions.description: The Treasurer position oversees all financial interactions for the Associated Student Body (ASB). Responsibilities include: record and approve all purchase orders, oversee all student club treasurers and provide assistance with any financial related questions, create financial code for the academic year to be used by the ASB and campus organizations, serve as chairman of the budget committee, and create the budget for the upcoming academic year.
